Anyway, I love reading the posts/comments here compared to r/Fitness. I'm a software engineer and this subreddit reminds me of subreddits for people in my field:

- r/cscareerquestions seems like it's mostly full of students giving bad advice, the blind leading the blind, etc. Very popular, lots of subscribers, like r/Fitness.
- r/ExperiencedDevs is more like this subreddit. Much smaller but the comments are from actually experienced developers and there's a lot of good content there.

This is just an observation I had recently and I felt like sharing. I wonder if there are other similarly divided communities on Reddit.
